literature_notes: All four ledger lines (L1–L4) describe the identical construct: full-length mouse 2B4 with EGFP fused to its C-terminus (2B4-EGFP), expressed retrovirally in primary T cells. CD244 is a type I single-pass transmembrane protein (extracellular 22–226, TM 227–248, intracellular 249–370). The C-terminus (residue 370) is therefore intracellular; the EGFP fusion is a cytoplasmic tag, not an extracellular surface tag. The construct is functionally validated — surface localisation confirmed by imaging, CD48-dependent microcluster formation preserved — but none of this constitutes evidence for an extracellular insertion. No ledger line reports any tag at the mature N-terminus (residue 22), in any extracellular loop, or anywhere in the ectodomain (22–226). Because the ledger contains no qualifying extracellular insertion, zero sites are proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal EGFP fusion on full-length mouse 2B4; tag is tolerated (surface expression and CD48-dependent microcluster formation confirmed) but the C-terminus lies in the intracellular domain (residues 249–370) and is not accessible on the extracellular face.
